jobs.occupation: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

• 
Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

• 
The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

• 
Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

• 
Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

• 
Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

• 
Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

• 
Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

• 
KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

• 
Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

• 
Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

• 
Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

• 
Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

• 
Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

jobs.occupation: Business Operations Program Manager, Global Data Centers (Danish)
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience in program or project management.

• Experience in corporate accounting, managing purchase order lifecycles, and accounts payable/receivable processes.

• Experience with facilities real estate management.

• Ability to communicate in Danish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in vendor relationships and agreement management.

• Experience in providing support for budgeting, forecasting, and purchase orders.

• Experience in SAP or equivalent.

• Experience with local authority, tax and administration.

**About The Job

**As a Data Center Site Business Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the service agreements of data center related systems. You will lead cost control, contractor management, and procurement projects, collaborating with other stakeholders (e.g., Environment, Health, and Safety department). You will actively support local data center technicians by ensuring they are sufficiently informed regarding relevant processes. You will serve as a local escalation point for finance related matters. You will support the site management and other Business Operations Program Managers in the global team in maintaining key metrics, providing data, and conducting analyses to facilitate informed decision-making.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.640000 - kr.655000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Lead annual budget development aligning with strategic objectives. Provide estimates for operational and capital budgets, regularly review and communicate budget reports with variance analysis and clear insights.

• Drive contract governance and vendor performance, utilizing benchmarking tools to analyze unit costs and identify redundancy reduction opportunities.

• Collect and analyze cost data, support management in maintaining key performance metrics, and provide insights for strategic planning. Evaluate proposals using a structured decision-making matrix and ensure seamless stakeholder communication.

• Facilitate the on-boarding process for new suppliers, ensuring they receive assistance in the local language, guidance on legal compliance, and acting as a local point of contact for audits.

• Execute assignments with varying supervision levels, showcasing self-initiative and adaptability. Manage tenders and agreements for essential services such as mechanical and electrical maintenance services, landscaping, cleaning, catering, waste disposal, and recycling.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you want to work at the intersection of technology, customers and product management, helping ensure that sensing products remain competitive, commercially attractive and easy to sell throughout their lifecycle?

Danfoss Sensing Solutions, part of Danfoss Climate Solutions, is looking for a Product Specialist to join our Application & Product Support organization. In this role, you will combine technical product knowledge with operational product management, supporting the day-to-day management of our sensor portfolio and ensuring that product data, documentation, pricing and commercial information are accurate and available to the organization.

You will work closely with Product Management, Sales, Engineering and Supply Chain. You will help turn decisions into practical implementation, coordinate activities across functions, and ensure that released products are properly maintained throughout their lifecycle.

The role offers an opportunity to build a broad understanding of sensing technologies, applications and commercial product management in an international organization.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Your responsibilities will include:

• Support Product Management in the day-to-day coordination of the sensor portfolio, helping maintain released products throughout their lifecycle and coordinating practical activities related to product introductions, product changes, phase-outs and other portfolio updates

• Maintain product master data, technical documentation, sales literature and pricing information, ensuring accuracy, consistency and availability across the organization

• Coordinate evaluations of new product variants and customer requests, driving implementation across Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain

• Act as a trusted product and application expert for internal stakeholders, supporting technical evaluations, product selection, customer interactions and training activities

• Drive coordination and continuous improvement activities that strengthen collaboration, simplify processes and improve product information quality across the organization

**What We're Looking For

**You are structured, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of operational tasks. You enjoy working with both technical and commercial topics and understand the importance of accuracy, timely follow-up and clear communication.

**In Addition, We Expect That

**

• You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Engineering or a related technical or commercial field and have experience from product support, product management, engineering, sales support or a similar role within a technical organization

• A genuine interest in sensing technologies and their applications is a strong plus. Experience with pressure, temperature or other sensing technologies is advantageous

• You understand, or are motivated to learn, the commercial and operational aspects of managing technical products throughout their lifecycle

• You are comfortable working with product data, technical documentation, pricing information and structured processes, bringing strong analytical and organizational skills.

• You have proven ability to coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders and functions, ensuring timely implementation and follow-through

• You are a proactive and service-oriented professional who builds strong relationships and understands that success comes from enabling teams across Danfoss to deliver results together. You are fluent in English, both spoken and written

Experience with product information management, ERP systems, master data, lifecycle management or technical documentation would be an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join an experienced and collaborative organization where technical knowledge, product understanding and customer needs come together. You will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of sensing technologies while gaining practical experience with operational product management and global product lifecycle processes.

We promote development from within and support learning through collaboration, mentoring, training and access to global opportunities.

You will have flexibility, autonomy and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We strive to create an inclusive working environment where people of different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and valued.

Benefits may include annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance and other locally applicable benefits.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the position, please contact, Director, Application & Product Support Christian Dall Larsen, +45 2966 7369

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**At Boozt, we are rethinking how we connect with our customers through data, personalisation, automation and AI. As our CRM setup continues to evolve, we are looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who wants to help shape the next chapter.

This is an opportunity to take an active role in developing how we work with marketing automation at Boozt. You will join a team with ambitions to make our communication smarter, more relevant and more data-driven, with room to challenge existing approaches and explore how new technology can improve the way we work.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise with curiosity and a drive to make things better, this is your chance to make a real impact on how we do CRM at Boozt.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of our CRM team, working hands-on with Salesforce Marketing Cloud to build and manage automated communications across email, app push and SMS. You will work closely with customer data to set up segmentation and personalisation, design targeted communications and continuously improve how we reach our customers.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Build and manage automated communications and recurring campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).

• 
Set up audience segmentation and personalisation using customer data, including SQL and AMPscript where relevant.

• 
Design and build personalised communications across email, app push and SMS.

• 
Analyse campaign performance, run A/B tests and use insights to improve results.

• 
Work closely with the CRM and market teams to ensure relevant communication across markets.

• 
Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we build, personalise and optimise customer communications.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You have hands-on experience with marketing automation and enjoy combining technical execution with analytical thinking and a curiosity for what is possible. You take ownership of your work, look for ways to improve and are comfortable exploring new approaches.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 
Around 3 years of experience with marketing automation, preferably within CRM.

• 
Experience with a platform such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Adobe, Agillic, Voyado, Bloomreach or Klaviyo.

• 
A solid understanding of segmentation, personalisation, automated journeys and campaign testing.

• 
Experience working with campaign KPIs and using data to improve performance.

• 
An interest in AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and how they can support your daily work.

• 
Strong written communication skills and fluency in English.

Experience with SQL and AMPscript, as well as working across multiple markets, is a plus.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will join a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you have the freedom and responsibility to make a real impact. As part of our CRM team, you will work at the intersection of customer experience, data, technology and commercial growth. This approximately 14-month maternity cover is an opportunity to take ownership, explore new ideas and help shape the customer experience for millions of customers while developing your skills in e-commerce CRM.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

About the job

You will join the Business Development team and work on projects across technical proposals, admin, contract management, and AI implementations.

Your responsibilities will include:

As Area Sales Manager, you will be central to Sievi’s transition from an agent-based model to a dedicated sales organisation in Denmark. Reporting directly to the International Sales Manager, you will take responsibility for developing the Danish market by strengthening relationships with distributors, industrial companies, and end-users.

This is a role with high visibility and responsibility, where your consultative approach and proactive market presence will help shape Sievi’s future growth in Denmark.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Drive sales and achieve budget targets through both account management and new business development.

• Maintain a strong market presence through regular customer visits and stakeholder engagement.

• Build close relationships with end-user stakeholders such as safety managers, union representatives, and company buyers.

• Collaborate closely with the Sales Director and International Sales to handle larger national accounts.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating Sievi’s product features (standards, durability, comfort, sustainability) into customer value.

The Candidate Profile

• Proven B2B sales experience from technical products, PPE, industrial products, construction, tools or related sectors.

• Strong relationship builder with a consultative approach, not transactional.

Why Join Sievi?

• Work in a market with real momentum: ongoing consolidation and shifts in the competitive landscape create clear opportunities to win new business.

• Take on a role with high visibility and responsibility, reporting directly to the International Sales Manager.

• Competitive compensation package including base salary, performance bonus, company car, pension, and benefits.

• This is a unique opportunity to join at an exciting stage. You will play a key role in establishing and expanding Sievi’s direct market presence in Denmark and have a genuine impact on the company’s future success.

Location

We are looking for an Area Sales Manager to cover Jutland and parts of Funen, with a particular focus on the Triangle Region (Vejle, Kolding and Middelfart).

Home-office based with frequent travel to customer sites.

How To Apply

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible, we process applications continuously. For further information, you are welcome to contact Susanne Jansen, Mercuri Urval, +45 6071 6044.

All inquiries are handled confidentially.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Project Manager to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

As Project Manager in NPI you will work closely together with optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers on maturing design and developing assembly and test processes. When the project has proven the product can be manufactured with satisfactory yield, it will be transferred to Operations, freeing up space and resources for the new next project.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead maturation and transfer projects of laser products.

• Be responsible for planning resource alignment, risk and change management, project reporting, and follow-up the gate process to ensure projects are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.

**What You Bring

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering.

**Essential

**

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex technical projects, ideally related to product development, product maturation, or technology transfer.

• Ability to effectively lead technical specialists and facilitate project meetings, design reviews, and key decision-making processes.

• Experience working in a manufacturing environment.

• Communicate fluently in English and thrive in cross-functional, international teams.

**What We Offer

**We want you to feel supported, both at work and outside it. Our benefits include:

• A 12% employer-paid pension contribution and health insurance.

• An annual bonus programme.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus five additional days once you have been with us for nine months.

• Access to thousands of courses through LinkedIn Learning.

• Wellbeing initiatives and an annual flu vaccination.

• Freshly prepared meals from our subsidised on-site canteen.

• Free parking at our Birkerød site.

• Social activities through our Employee Association.

_Benefits are subject to eligibility and the relevant plan or policy terms.

_**Practical Information

**

• Working arrangement: On site

• Working language: English

• Employment: Full time

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.description:
At Konica Minolta, we believe great workplaces are built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a Nordic Quality Manager who is passionate about creating structure, driving positive change, and helping our Nordic organization operate at high standards of quality, sustainability, and information security.

This is not just a compliance role. It is an opportunity to influence how we work, support leaders and teams across the Nordics, and make a real impact on our customers, employees, and business.

What you'll be doing

As one of our Nordic Quality Managers, you will help to improve our Integrated Management System (IMS), covering Quality, Environment, and Information Security. You will work closely with colleagues across the Nordic countries and be a trusted advisor to the business.

Some of your key responsibilities will include:

• Driving the development and implementation of our IMS strategy across the Nordic region

• Maintaining and improving processes, policies, and tools related to quality management, environmental management, and information security

• Leading internal and external audits within ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001

• Supporting governance initiatives and reporting activities

• Delivering engaging training and awareness activities across the organization

• Acting as a trusted advisor and collaborating with external stakeholders, certification bodies, customers, and internal teams across the Nordics

• Traveling to Konica Minolta offices across the Nordics 10-15 days per year

What success looks like

You create clarity where others see complexity.

You build strong partnerships across the business and inspire others to embrace quality and continuous improvement.

You balance attention to detail with a practical business mindset and know how to turn requirements into value for the organization.

What we're looking for

We know that great candidates do not always tick every box. If you are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every requirement.

Ideally, you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of experience working with ISO management systems, preferably ISO 9001, 14001 and/or 27001

• Knowledge of quality management, information security, sustainability, or related disciplines

• Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders at different levels

• A structured and proactive approach

• Experience managing projects or driving organizational improvements

• Professional English skills, written and spoken

Why join Konica Minolta?

At Konica Minolta, you will become part of a supportive Nordic team where collaboration comes naturally and where your contribution truly matters. Working together with another Nordic Quality Manager and reporting to the Nordic Head of Legal & Compliance, you will play a key role in driving quality and continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

We offer:

• Meaningful work with a clear purpose

• Nordic collaboration and international exposure

• Opportunity to influence strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• Flexible ways of working

• A culture built on trust, accountability, inclusion, and collaboration

About Konica Minolta as a workplace

At Konica Minolta, we value different perspectives and actively work to create an environment where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity in experience, background, and ways of thinking makes us stronger. This employer-branding wording is reflected in the attached recruitment material.

We offer a professional environment with strong collaboration, flexibility in everyday work, and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital development across the business. The attached recruitment template also highlights benefits such as pension, health insurance, lunch arrangement, fitness facilities, and social activities.

Practical information

• Location: Copenhagen / Ballerup area, onsite setup

• Employment type: Full-time

• Salary: According to qualifications

• Employment date: 1st of January 2027 or before

How to apply

Please send your application and CV no later than 10 November 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to connect with our Head of Nordic Legal & Compliance, Kristian Øhrstrøm at Kristian.Ohrstrom@konicaminolta.dk.

Feel free to submit your application already today – we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right match. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Konica Minolta:

Konica Minolta Business Solutions Denmark a/s is a leading provider of printing solutions for office and production environments. Our portfolio ranges from hardware and print software to automation and data security, and we also deliver solutions within Document Management and Cyber Security.

In Denmark, we have approximately 120 employees and an annual revenue of DKK 260 million, spanning sales, service, and support across IT, print and copy solutions, as well as digital services. Globally, Konica Minolta employs around 40,000 people.

www.konicaminolta.dk

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is an advanced systems and industrialization company developing integrated technology platforms for demanding aerospace, security, and mission-critical applications. Its mission is to transform operationally validated technologies into scalable, ready-to-deploy systems by combining advanced engineering, industrial partnerships, and strong governance.

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development. The site will build core capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, industrialization, and deployment of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be an advanced aerospace signal-intelligence product platform covering RF and system architecture, antenna-system design, RF and microwave hardware, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for qualification, production, and operational deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and international deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s mechanical design capability for antenna and RF systems. The role is intended for an experienced mechanical engineer with prior hands-on experience developing the mechanical implementation of antenna, RF, or microwave hardware.

You will design and develop mechanical solutions for antenna systems and associated RF and electronic assemblies. The work includes antenna supports and mounts, RF-aware enclosures, radomes, fixed and, where applicable, deployable antenna mechanisms, test fixtures, thermal solutions, connector integration, cable routing, sealing, environmental protection, and platform interfaces. Many of these structures can directly affect antenna and RF performance, requiring close co-design with antenna and RF engineers.

The role covers mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing-process selection, structural and thermal analysis, tolerance definition, detailed CAD design, prototyping, assembly, environmental validation, serviceability, and production release. Particular attention will be given to mechanical structures that directly affect antenna performance, integration, alignment, stability, and deployment.

You will work closely with antenna systems engineers, RF and microwave hardware engineers, system architects, RF test and characterization engineers, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams. The role requires strong mechanical design expertise, RF-aware product thinking, end-to-end technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototype build and qualification to documented, manufacturable antenna assemblies and integrated systems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system, antenna, and platform requirements into mechanical architectures, interface definitions, design constraints, and technical trade-offs.

• Design mechanical components and assemblies for antenna systems, including supports, mounts, frames, radomes, RF-aware enclosures, fixed or deployable mechanisms, and platform-integration structures.

• Own the detailed mechanical implementation of antenna and RF assemblies, including 3D CAD models, 2D manufacturing drawings, GD&T, assembly-level tolerance analysis, BOMs, and configuration-controlled documentation.

• Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance.

• Integrate RF modules, antennas, electronics, connectors, cables, gaskets, thermal interfaces, and environmental sealing into complete mechanical assemblies.

• Perform structural, thermal, and tolerance analyses covering stiffness, strength, mass properties, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, and expected environmental loads.

• Define mechanical requirements and work jointly with antenna and RF engineers to establish electromagnetic constraints for radomes, covers, supports, enclosures, and other structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Design antenna deployment and positioning mechanisms, where applicable, including hinges, latches, restraints, stops, alignment features, and associated interfaces.

• Design test fixtures, alignment tools, handling aids, assembly tooling, and prototype-support hardware for antenna and RF system development.

• Select materials, coatings, surface treatments, fasteners, adhesives, seals, bearings, and manufacturing processes based on structural, thermal, RF, environmental, corrosion, and production requirements.

• Lead mechanical prototype build, assembly, troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Contribute to environmental testing and qualification, including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, and other relevant mechanical validation activities.

• Apply design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost considerations throughout development.

• Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on technical clarification, process selection, prototype production, inspection, non-conformance resolution, and production release.

• Prepare mechanical specifications, analysis reports, interface-control documentation, design-review materials, assembly instructions, and production handover documentation.

• Collaborate with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and engineering workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

Required qualifications and experience

• Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 5+ years of professional mechanical design experience, including demonstrated experience developing mechanical hardware for antenna, RF, or microwave systems where mechanical geometry, materials, interfaces, tolerances, or nearby structures directly influence electromagnetic performance.

• Strong hands-on experience and demonstrated technical ownership of complex mechanical assemblies from initial architecture and concept through detailed design, prototype build, verification, qualification, and production release.

• Advanced proficiency with a professional 3D CAD and drafting environment; SolidWorks experience is preferred.

• Strong command of GD&T, engineering drawing standards, assembly-level tolerance analysis, and production-quality mechanical documentation.

• Demonstrated experience designing mechanical components or assemblies for antenna, RF, or microwave systems, such as antenna supports and mounts, frames, enclosures, radomes, mechanisms, fixtures, or other mechanically and electromagnetically constrained structures.

• Experience with mechanical packaging and integration of antennas, RF modules, PCBs, connectors, cables, thermal interfaces, shielding, grounding, seals, and associated electronics.

• Practical understanding of RF-aware mechanical design, including the effects of materials, structures, clearances, alignment, grounding, shielding, cabling, and radomes on antenna and RF performance.

• Experience applying engineering calculations and simulation methods, including finite-element analysis where appropriate, to support structural and thermal design decisions.

• Understanding of stiffness, strength, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, fatigue, and other relevant environmental loads.

• Practical knowledge of metallic materials, engineering polymers, elastomers, composites, adhesives, coatings, and surface treatments.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as precision machining, sheet-metal fabrication, additive manufacturing, composite manufacturing, joining, fastening, sealing, and assembly.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with prototype assembly, mechanical troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Experience supporting environmental testing and qualification, such as vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, or comparable validation activities.

• Experience working with suppliers and manufacturing teams on process selection, technical clarification, inspection, non-conformance resolution, manufacturability, and production handover.

Nice to have

• Experience developing lightweight, stiffness-critical structures with stringent alignment and dimensional-stability requirements.

• Experience with aerospace or space-hardware qualification, including thermal-vacuum testing, outgassing constraints, vibration, and shock.

• Experience with precision mechanical alignment, dimensional inspection, antenna positioning, and calibration or verification fixtures.

• Experience designing IP-rated enclosures or ruggedized outdoor electronic equipment.

• Experience with product data management, configuration control, and release processes for complex mechanical assemblies.

• Experience working with international suppliers and manufacturing partners on low-volume, high-complexity hardware.

• Experience designing radomes, RF-transparent structures, or mechanical structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Experience with mechanically steerable, deployable, foldable, or position-critical antenna systems.

• Experience working directly with antenna or electromagnetic simulation engineers to iterate mechanical geometry, materials, and interfaces based on RF performance.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take end-to-end technical ownership of one or more mechanical subsystems or integration areas for antenna and RF systems.

• Establish the initial mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing approach, and platform-integration plan for the assigned scope.

• Deliver reviewed 3D models, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analyses, interface definitions, and supporting design documentation.

• Develop and support the build, assembly, and verification of initial mechanical prototypes, fixtures, or engineering models.

• Identify key structural, thermal, alignment, sealing, deployment, and manufacturability risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, supplier, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and release workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

At IST, we're building the cloud platform that powers educational solutions used by more than five million users across Europe. That means the abstraction stops with us: when a node misbehaves, there's no support ticket to a hyperscaler.

There's a rack, and someone who knows it.

We're looking for a Cloud Engineer who finds that appealing rather than daunting.

About the role

As a Cloud Engineer, you'll help design, build and operate the IST Cloud Platform — from the automation and orchestration layers our developers build on, all the way down to the switches, servers and cabling that carry it. You'll do this together with our Cloud Engineering team, architects, developers and stakeholders, whether the work happens at a keyboard or in a rack.

In practice, around a quarter of your time will be spent physically on site in the data center. Not as a separate duty, but as a natural part of the work: expanding capacity for a new cluster the team has just automated, replacing a switch that's been throwing errors in your own monitoring, tracing a network issue that turns out to be a cable rather than a config. Owning the platform end to end is what makes this role different from a pure cloud position.

The role is based at our office in Roskilde, Denmark, with the primary data center within reach. Some travel is required, primarily to our office in Växjö, Sweden.

Just as importantly, you're comfortable at both ends of the stack. You can discuss platform architecture with our developers in the morning and spend the afternoon in the rack with a screwdriver, and you see those as the same job rather than two different ones. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• A collaborative, decisive and pragmatic approach to problem-solving

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. We apply an office-first policy, and given the hands-on nature of this role, regular physical presence at the office and in the datacenter is part of the job. Within that framework, there's room for flexibility on the days where your work doesn't require you on site.

You'll join an international and collaborative environment where you'll have real ownership, influence over strategic technology decisions, and the chance to help shape the future of learning.

jobs.occupation: PhD Scholarship in Machine Learning for Non-Stationary and Non-Static Nano-Tomography - DTU Compute
jobs.description:
Recent advances in machine learning and deep learning are opening new possibilities for computational imaging, including the reconstruction of complex 3D structures from experimental imaging data. In this fully funded PhD project at DTU Compute, you will develop novel learning-based methods for X-ray nano-tomography. As state-of-the-art synchrotron imaging systems push towards ever higher spatial resolution, even minute positioning errors, mechanical drift, and sample deformations become sources of image degradation. The central challenge is to reconstruct accurate 3D and 4D representations of samples while accounting for positional uncertainties during image acquisition and changes in sample shape over time.

The project will bring together neural representations, inverse problems, geometric modeling, and computational imaging to address fundamental challenges in nano-tomography. Rather than correcting acquisition errors and sample deformations as separate preprocessing steps, you will investigate how to model and estimate the sample structure, acquisition geometry, and deformation jointly from the measured data.

The position is based at DTU Compute and conducted in close collaboration with EPFL and the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) in Switzerland, one of the leading centers for synchrotron X-ray imaging. As a PhD student, you will work in an international research environment spanning DTU, EPFL, and PSI, combining expertise in both machine learning and computational imaging with access to experimental data and advanced imaging facilities. Research visits to Switzerland are planned as part of the project.

Responsibilities

• Develop novel machine learning and deep learning methods for X-ray nano-tomography, which jointly reconstruct sample structure, acquisition geometry, and deformation fields from inconsistent projection data.
• Investigate neural field representations for 3D and 4D imaging, including models that capture changes in sample geometry over time, and explore hybrid approaches combining learning-based methods with physical models of image formation and tomographic reconstruction.
• Validate and evaluate the developed methods using experimental nano-tomography data, initially focusing on integrated circuits.
• Collaborate with researchers at DTU, PSI, and EPFL, and participate in international research visits and scientific activities.
• Publish research results in leading journals and conferences in machine learning, computer vision, and computational imaging.
• Contribute to research-based teaching and supervision of MSc and BSc student projects.
• Participate in activities within the Center for Quantification of Imaging Data from MAX IV (QIM), including workshops, training courses, and interdisciplinary research collaborations.
Qualifications
You are curious and motivated by developing new machine learning methods to solve challenging problems in computational imaging. A strong background in machine learning and deep learning is particularly important. We welcome candidates from computer science, applied mathematics, physics, engineering, and related disciplines who are interested in combining modern learning methods with mathematical modeling and real-world experimental data. The candidate should be able to work independently, contribute effectively to an interdisciplinary research team, and communicate scientific ideas clearly in written and spoken English.

To succeed in this position, you are expected to have:

• A master's degree in computer science, applied mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.
• A strong background in machine learning and deep learning, including experience developing, implementing, or evaluating learning-based models.
• Experience with scientific programming, preferably in Python, and familiarity with relevant machine learning frameworks.
• A solid understanding of mathematical modeling, optimization, or numerical methods.
Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage:

• Neural representations, implicit neural fields, or other coordinate-based representations.
• Computer vision, 3D vision, geometric modeling, or structure-from-motion.
• Inverse problems, image reconstruction, or physics-informed machine learning.
• Image registration, motion estimation, or deformable modeling.
• Image processing, image analysis, or tomographic reconstruction.
• Knowledge of X-ray imaging and tomography is beneficial but not required. 
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

At DTU Compute, we have a large focus on creating a good working environment. Our work with diversity and inclusion is an essential part of that. We believe that having a good working environment is a necessary foundation to provide excellent research, teaching, supervision and innovation.

At DTU Compute, we have about 140 PhD students. We offer several events and activities for all our PhD students such as annual PhD Bazaar, onboarding course where you will meet other PhD students, and you can join our PhD Club that organizes BBQs, board games events, lunches etc. 

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Hans Martin Kjer, hmkj@dtu.dk. 

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 16 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Compute
DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We broadly cover digital technologies within mathematics, data science, computer science, and computer engineering, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, internet of things (IoT), chip design, cybersecurity, human-computer interaction, social networks, fairness, and data ethics. Our research is rooted in basic research and centres on mathematical models of the physical and virtual world, as a basis for the analysis, design, and implementation of complex systems. We focus on ensuring that our research results contribute to creating a better society by supporting areas such as health, green transition, energy supply, and life science. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. Read more here: www.compute.dtu.dk.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Entrepreneurship, AI, and Labor Market Disruption - DTU Entrepreneurship
jobs.description:
Are you interested in exploring the following questions? 

• How are artificial intelligence (AI) and automation reshaping individuals' transitions to entrepreneurship?
• How do individuals' skills, experience, and technological readiness influence the types of businesses they create and their subsequent performance?
• How do these patterns vary across countries and institutional contexts?
DTU Entrepreneurship invites applications for a three-year PhD scholarship as part of an international research project entitled The New Landscape of Necessity Entrepreneurship: Understanding Entrepreneurial Transitions in an Era of AI- and Automation-Driven Labor Market Disruption.

The project investigates how AI and automation reshape entrepreneurial transitions, with particular attention to individuals who start businesses following unemployment. The PhD candidate will join an international research team involving Associate Professor Argyro (Iro) Nikiforou at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Professor Marc Gruber at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), Switzerland, and Professor John C. Dencker at Northeastern University, USA. Funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF), the project combines large-scale surveys, Danish administrative registry data, and qualitative interviews across Denmark, Switzerland, and Greece.

The position offers an opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge entrepreneurship research, work with rich international datasets, and collaborate with leading scholars in the field.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your primary responsibility will be to conduct high-quality research within the international project, with opportunities to develop your own research questions within its overall scope.

Your tasks will include:

• Developing research questions and theoretical frameworks concerning entrepreneurship, human capital, AI, and labor market transitions.
• Applying quantitative and qualitative research methods to investigate entrepreneurial transitions and outcomes.
• Collecting, managing, and analyzing quantitative data, including large-scale surveys and Danish registry data.
• Contributing to the design and implementation of surveys and qualitative interviews in collaboration with international research partners.
• Preparing research papers for submission to leading international academic journals.
• Presenting research findings at international conferences and contributing to dissemination activities targeting policymakers and other stakeholders.
• Collaborating with researchers at DTU, EPFL, Northeastern University, and other project partners.
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in entrepreneurship research and technological change.

We expect you to have:

• A Master’s degree.
• A strong interest in developing quantitative research and analytical skills.
• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
• The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international research environment.
The following qualifications would be considered an advantage, but are not required:

• Experience working with large-scale datasets, registry data, or longitudinal data.
• Experience with statistical software such as Stata or R, and familiarity with econometric techniques, including regression analysis and panel data methods. 
• Experience with survey design, qualitative interviewing, or mixed-methods research.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of applicants will be conducted by Associate Professor Argyro (Iro) Nikiforou, who will serve as the principal supervisor.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The expected starting date is as soon as possible or as agreed with the successful candidate.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Argyro (Iro) Nikiforou, DTU Entrepreneurship, Technical University of Denmark, at argnik@dtu.dk.

You can read more about DTU Entrepreneurship at www.entrepreneurship.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 8 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Entrepreneurship is amongst the leading international entities in technology entrepreneurship and helps develop an entrepreneurial culture across DTU. As part of a dynamic and evolving ecosystem, we combine practice-oriented education and research in entrepreneurship with real start-up opportunities from all DTU departments. With rigorous research at its core, the Center builds the entrepreneurial capabilities of students, industry leaders, academics and policymakers to address unsolved problems, and together create new knowledge, methodologies and initiatives. We enable ethically minded entrepreneurs to build solutions that benefit people, society and the world. The Center experiments with new entrepreneurial methodologies and activities to push boundaries within research and education.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Data Migration Consultant to Scan Global Logistics
jobs.description:
Join an International Transformation Program at Scan Global Logistics

Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about working with data? Do you enjoy identifying errors, improving data quality, and ensuring that information is accurate and ready for use?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a Data Migration Consultant to join its migration team and support an international transformation program. You will play an important role in migrating data between existing applications, ensuring high data quality and supporting successful system implementations across multiple countries.

You do not need to be an expert in a specific ERP platform. What matters most is your practical experience with data migration, your Excel skills, and your ability to spot inconsistencies and solve data-related problems.

Your role

You will become part of a close-knit team that works together to ensure successful data migrations and regular go-lives. The team values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and helping each other succeed.

Your main responsibility will be to work hands-on with data, from analysing existing datasets to validating migrated data and identifying issues that need to be resolved.

Key responsibilities

• Support data migration between existing applications and new systems.

• Analyse and validate data using Excel to ensure accuracy and completeness.

• Identify errors, duplicates, missing information, and data inconsistencies.

• Perform data cleansing, reconciliation, and quality checks.

• Investigate discrepancies and coordinate their resolution with relevant stakeholders.

• Ensure data is ready for testing, migration, and go-live.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries.

• Contribute to improving data migration processes and working methods.

What we are looking for

• Practical experience with data migration between systems or applications.

• Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach to analysing data.

• Experience identifying data errors and ensuring data quality.

• An analytical mindset and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.

• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different stakeholders.

• A proactive attitude and the ability to take ownership of your tasks.

• A willingness to share knowledge, ask questions, and learn from colleagues.

Experience with ERP systems, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle, is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with SQL, data analysis tools, testing, or go-live activities is also beneficial.

What you can expect

• An opportunity to contribute to a large international transformation program.

• A supportive team where colleagues share knowledge and help each other.

• A varied role with regular go-lives and practical data challenges.

• Collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries.

• The opportunity to contribute to smarter and more automated ways of working, including the use of AI.

• Opportunities for professional development and relevant training.

About you

You are curious, methodical, and comfortable working with details. You enjoy getting to the bottom of data issues and take pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.

You are comfortable working independently while recognising the value of teamwork and sparring with experienced colleagues. You communicate clearly, follow up on outstanding issues, and remain focused on delivering results.

Location and language

The position is based in Hvidovre, Denmark, with collaboration across an international organisation. No regular travel is expected.

You must be comfortable communicating in English. Danish is not a requirement.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Ready to learn new skills?

We are looking for a dedicated Tire Fitter for a client in the Kolding area. No prior experience is needed—if you have the right attitude and a good mood, they will teach you the rest!

What You Get

• 
Position: Full-time temporary position starting as soon as possible until early or mid-December.

• 
Salary: DKK 173.60/hour + pension, holiday pay, and special savings.

• 
Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM (overtime may occur).

• 
Workplace: A fast-paced, informal environment with great colleagues and humor in Kolding.

What We Expect

• 
You have a valid Category B driver's license.

• 
You are responsible, independent, and in good physical shape.

• 
You speak and understand English or Danish.

• 
Experience with tires is a plus, but not a requirement!

• 

Why Work with HumanizeR?

• 
Flexible opportunities to fit your schedule.

• 
Great way to earn extra money and gain experience.

• 
Many of our temporary positions lead to permanent jobs.

Apply Today!

Ready to join the team? Create your profile at Humanizer.dk and make sure to mark it "tyre fitter".

**Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed.

**Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority.

We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

The role

We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.

You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.

What you'll be working on

• Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams.

• Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation.

• Design and run experiments — from hypothesis to conclusion.

• Analyse user behaviour and funnels to identify growth opportunities and friction points.

• Build scalable dashboards and reporting in close collaboration with the data team.

• Translate findings into concrete recommendations for product leadership and senior stakeholders.

What you bring

• Strong SQL skills and experience with complex data modelling.

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Lightdash, Evidence or comparable tooling.

• Solid product analytics experience — you've worked closely with product teams and understand what drives a digital product.

• Strong experimentation design and statistical analysis skills.

• A track record of owning a product analytics function, not just contributing to one.

• Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Self-directed and structured — you can take an ambiguous question and turn it into a sharp analysis.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse.

• Experience with Lightdash, Tableau, or comparable BI tools.

• Python for data processing and analysis.

What we offer

• Ownership of the product analytics function at one of Denmark's fastest-growing fintech companies.

• Direct influence on product direction and a seat at the table where decisions are made.

• A strong data team with high professional standards and a modern tech stack.

• The opportunity to build something — not inherit a finished function.

• Office first in Copenhagen — five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch at Claus Meyer, dinner covered if the day runs long.

Practical

Start: As soon as possible

Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Salary: Competitive and based on experience

Working place: Onsite in central Copenhagen

Our lean recruitment process

• 20-minute vibe-check with The Hub (online).

• 45-minute onsite meeting with the hiring manager and product manager.

• 1-hour onsite case session with the hiring manager and a team member, followed by a 30-minute conversation with Nikolai (CEO).

We look forward to hearing from you! If you're an early-career product analyst with 2-3 years of experience, we're also looking for a Product Analyst (non-lead) to join our team. You'll find the job post here on The Hub.
